legal.privacy.meta.title: Privacy Policy
legal.privacy.meta.description: Privacy policy of Indice Technologies Inc. for visitors, prospects, and users who interact with the Indice website.
legal.privacy.hero.title: Privacy Policy
legal.privacy.hero.subtitle: This policy explains what information we collect, why we use it, who it may be shared with, and how you can exercise your rights.
legal.privacy.intro.title: Our commitment
legal.privacy.intro.text: At Indice, we protect the personal information we receive through our website, forms, demo requests, commercial communications, and processes related to our platform. We process data in a limited, proportional way to provide information, support, and business services.
legal.privacy.responsible.title: Organization responsible
legal.privacy.responsible.text: The organization responsible for information collected through this site is:
legal.privacy.data.title: Information we may collect
legal.privacy.data.text: Depending on how you interact with Indice, we may collect:
legal.privacy.data.item_1: Contact details such as name, email address, phone number, country, and company.
legal.privacy.data.item_2: Messages, questions, demo requests, and commercial preferences.
legal.privacy.data.item_3: Registration information or interest in plans, modules, and services.
legal.privacy.data.item_4: Technical data such as IP address, browser type, device, date, time, logs, and pages visited.
legal.privacy.data.item_5: Data generated by cookies, analytics, or similar technologies.
legal.privacy.data.item_6: Information needed for security, abuse prevention, and site protection.
legal.privacy.data.item_7: Payment or billing data when applicable, mainly processed by external providers such as Stripe or the app.indiceapp.com platform.
legal.privacy.uses.title: How we use information
legal.privacy.uses.item_1: Respond to information, contact, support, or demo requests.
legal.privacy.uses.item_2: Follow up commercially with prospects and interested companies.
legal.privacy.uses.item_3: Manage registrations, trials, plans, payments, or implementation when applicable.
legal.privacy.uses.item_4: Send communications related to Indice, always in accordance with applicable law.
legal.privacy.uses.item_5: Improve the website, measure performance, understand usage, and optimize campaigns.
legal.privacy.uses.item_6: Protect site security and prevent spam, fraud, unauthorized access, or abuse.
legal.privacy.uses.item_7: Comply with legal, tax, contractual, or authority requirements.
legal.privacy.sharing.title: Who we may share information with
legal.privacy.sharing.text: We do not sell personal information. We may share it in a limited way with providers and partners that help us operate the site and provide services.
legal.privacy.sharing.item_1: Hosting, infrastructure, security, and storage providers.
legal.privacy.sharing.item_2: Email, form, CRM, support, or commercial communication services.
legal.privacy.sharing.item_3: Analytics, measurement, advertising, or site improvement tools.
legal.privacy.sharing.item_4: Payment processors, including Stripe, when a user starts a payment or subscription.
legal.privacy.sharing.item_5: The app.indiceapp.com platform when registration, trial, or service is managed through that application.
legal.privacy.sharing.item_6: Competent authorities when there is a legal obligation or valid request.
legal.privacy.transfers.title: International transfers
legal.privacy.transfers.text: Indice Technologies Inc. operates from Canada and may use providers located in Canada, the United States, Mexico, Colombia, or other countries. By submitting information, you acknowledge that your data may be processed outside your country of residence under reasonable safeguards.
legal.privacy.retention.title: Retention
legal.privacy.retention.text: We retain information only as long as necessary for the purposes described, commercial relationships, requests, security records, or legal obligations. When it is no longer needed, we seek to delete or anonymize it.
legal.privacy.cookies.title: Cookies and analytics
legal.privacy.cookies.text: The site may use cookies, local storage, logs, and analytics tools to remember preferences, measure visits, improve content, and protect forms. You can configure your browser to block cookies, although some functions may be affected.
legal.privacy.security.title: Security
legal.privacy.security.text: We apply reasonable measures to protect information, including access controls, form validation, abuse protection, and restrictions on sensitive files. No system is completely infallible, so we cannot guarantee absolute security.
legal.privacy.rights.title: Your rights
legal.privacy.rights.text: Depending on your country, you may have rights to access, correct, update, delete, object, port, withdraw consent, or limit the use of your data.
legal.privacy.rights.item_1: Request access to personal information we hold about you.
legal.privacy.rights.item_2: Ask us to correct or update incomplete or inaccurate data.
legal.privacy.rights.item_4: Object to or withdraw consent for commercial communications.
legal.privacy.rights.item_5: Raise concerns with the competent privacy or data protection authority.
legal.privacy.rights.note: To exercise rights, write to contacto@indiceapp.com. We may request additional information to verify your identity and handle the request securely.
legal.privacy.minors.title: Minors
legal.privacy.minors.text: The Indice site and services are intended for businesses and adults. We do not intentionally seek to collect information from minors.
legal.privacy.changes.title: Changes to this policy
legal.privacy.changes.text: We may update this policy to reflect legal, operational, or technological changes. The current version will be posted on this page with its update date.
legal.privacy.contact.title: Privacy contact
legal.privacy.contact.text: For questions, requests, or concerns about privacy and personal data processing, you can write to contacto@indiceapp.com.
